name: 28320-solodecode-qwen35-27bfp8-tp4
model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-27B-FP8, the checkpoint's own block-FP8 release. Ungated, apache-2.0, 30.9 GB of weights in 11 shards.
hardware: 4x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, NVLink-connected.
parallelism: tp4, pp1, dp1, ep1. Every dimension of this checkpoint divides cleanly at four.
architecture: Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration, a GDN-hybrid dense model: 64 decoder layers on full_attention_interval 4; the rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 48 requests with a 2400 s safety cap; 36 requests are scored.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, 2048 prompt tokens and exactly 1024 output tokens per request, `ignore_eos: true`, `temperature: 0.0`. No shared prefix and no prefix cache.
purpose: A single-user long-form drafting assistant on a 27-billion-parameter model, writing 1024-token answers from 2048-token prompts across four GPUs.
launch:
# sglang server arguments. Flat `key: value` only -- a nested block is DROPPED by the reader, and
# a bool is a FLAG: `true` emits `--key`, `false` emits nothing.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3.5-27B-FP8

tp-size: 4

# One request in flight with a ceiling of two: `streams` may move within [1, 2] and no further.
max-running-requests: 2

# The longest request is 2048 + 1024 = 3072, so nothing is truncated. Load-bearing rather than
# cosmetic: the checkpoint advertises 262144 positions and the engine sizes device-side
# per-request tables from that number.
context-length: 8192

# Written out rather than left to auto-selection: the omitted-key failure is silent, because a
# host that fails the Hopper probe falls back to triton and serves a different attention path.
attention-backend: fa3

# Synthetic prompts share no prefix worth reusing, so every request pays the same prefill.
disable-radix-cache: true

mem-fraction-static: 0.85
random-seed: 28320
